---
title: "About this site"
---

This interactive dashboard contains information about food access for higher education institutions in Erie County, NY.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" icon=false title="Note on AI use"}
Although this project does not include components of AI data outputs, some code chunks were created with the "help" of Perplexity AI. 

Even though I personally do not encourage using AI in your daily tasks and refrain from using it in my daily life, I used Perplexity AI as a learning tool and as a testing ground to experiment with some of the ideas I have for this project as a complete beginner.

Any output was checked against existing public resources like [R-Bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com/), [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/), [Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co/), [rOpenSci](https://ropensci.org/), and [RProject subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/RProject/). For visual display references, I used [Quarto's official guide](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/).

If you like any aspect of this project, I would highly recommend triple checking my data and resources before incorporating them into your own project. 

Thank you!
:::

## Materials & methods

\[\~ 200 words\]

Narrative: Clear narrative description of the data sources and methods. Includes data from at least two sources that were integrated / merged in R.

Code: The code associated with the project is well organized and easy to follow. Demonstrates mastery of R graphics and functions.

Data: The underlying data are publicly accessible via the web and downloaded/accessed within the Rmd script. If you want to use your own data, you must make it available on a website (e.g. Figshare) so that others are able to re-run your code.

Load any required packages in a code chunk (you may need to install some packages):

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(kableExtra)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(widgetframe)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(widgetframe_widgets_dir = 'widgets' ) 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache=TRUE)  # cache the results for quick compiling
```

## Data & Sources

NYSED Higher Education Institution Directory\
[**NYSED Erie County profile**](https://data.nysed.gov/profile.php?county=14)\
*New York State Education Department*

The institution list is extracted from the higher education institutions section of NYSED's Erie County profile. Institutions listed in the separate closed institutions section are excluded. The extraction is run separately in RStudio. This webpage displays the saved Markdown table; rendering the website does not refresh the institution list.

Geography: Erie County, New York

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
n=20
data=data.frame(x=runif(n,-180,180),
                y=runif(n,-60,60),
                size = runif(n, 5, 20),
                category = factor(
                  sample(letters[1:5], n, replace = TRUE)
                  ),
                value = rnorm(n))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
data %>% 
  slice(1:10) %>% #show only 1:n rows
  kable(digits=2,align="c")%>% #make table and round to two digits
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = 
                  c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) #apply other formatting
```
